title: South Korea Monitors North Korean Border Incursions, Maintains Readiness
detail: South Korea's military said it is monitoring North Korean border incursions along the shared frontier and maintaining heightened readiness. Seoul confirmed ongoing surveillance operations in response to DPRK activity near the demilitarized zone.

title: Kim Jong-un Publicly Thanks Troops on 'Overseas Military Operations' in Founding Anniversary Speech
detail: In a speech at Pyongyang's assembly hall marking the DPRK's 78th founding anniversary on September 9, 2026, Kim Jong-un thanked workers and Korean People's Army service members, extending what KCNA described as 'special gratitude and respect' to commanders and soldiers 'participating in overseas military operations' — understood to reference North Korean troops deployed to fight for Russia in Ukraine. Neither Kim nor KCNA named Russia or Ukraine explicitly, but analysts called it the most explicit public acknowledgment yet of DPRK troops' combat role, coming after Seoul's Defense Intelligence Agency estimated more than 16,000 troops sent cumulatively since October 2024. Chinese President Xi Jinping separately sent a congratulatory message to Kim on the anniversary.

media.caption: Kim Jong-un delivers a speech marking the DPRK's 78th founding anniversary at Pyongyang Assembly Hall, Sept 9, 2026
